pass_tags.one-pass: Math or document High. Target review about 3 minutes.
pass_tags.second-eye: Judgment High. Target review about 5 minutes.
pass_tags.tray-skim: Medium optional tray. Target skim about 2 minutes.

types.name: QBI
types.trigger_summary: Math gap between the tentative QBI deduction and the deduction taken. SSTB never raises confidence; it is a gate only.

types.name: S-corp reasonable compensation
types.trigger_summary: S corporation distributions are present and officer W-2 is near zero.

types.name: S-corp conversion (SE)
types.trigger_summary: Business signal is Schedule C, a Schedule SE form, or present self-employment income. High when that income is at least $100,000, or an explicit compensation figure leaves a gap of at least $25,000. High only. Already an S corporation, Form 1120-S, a multi-owner Form 1065, K-1 only, a loss, near-zero profit, missing SE, or W-2-only stays silent. A one-year spike does not silence it. SSTB does not raise confidence.

types.name: SEP / Solo
types.trigger_summary: Self-employment income above the floor and retirement deduction exactly zero. A small deduction stays silent. No Solo versus SEP product talk.

types.name: Cash-balance
types.trigger_summary: Earned income above the hard floor and retirement deduction exactly zero. No product pick. This pass never emits High.

types.name: 2210 underpayment
types.trigger_summary: Form 2210 underpayment math only.

types.name: Charitable bunching / DAF
types.trigger_summary: Schedule A charitable or Form 8283, or standard deduction plus prior-year Schedule A charitable of at least $5,000. Never High.

types.name: QCD
types.trigger_summary: Age at least 70½, an IRA or Form 1099-R, and a charitable pattern.

types.name: Wash / loss room
types.trigger_summary: Wash sale on Form 8949 or Schedule D loss room. No harvest flag without lots.

types.name: Passive 8582 absorb
types.trigger_summary: Form 8582 suspended loss and current-year passive income. Grouping is not a High without prior election documents.

types.name: Passive grouping
types.trigger_summary: Form 8582 and multiple activities. Medium only. This pass does not emit High.

types.name: Home office
types.trigger_summary: Schedule C or S corporation plus Form 8829 or explicit home-office context. A complete Form 8829 with no gap stays silent. Ownership alone stays silent.

types.name: Auto mileage
types.trigger_summary: Business activity plus a vehicle signal. W-2 unreimbursed expenses alone stay silent.

types.name: §179 / bonus
types.trigger_summary: Material additions, little §179 or bonus taken, and taxable income that absorbs. Thin taxable income stays silent.

types.name: HSA
types.trigger_summary: W-2 and Form 8889 mismatch.

types.name: Dependents / education
types.trigger_summary: CTC or ODC gap is in scope. Education is High only when Form 1098-T is in the packet.

types.name: Cost segregation
types.cite: Cost segregation — ROI is a human gate
types.trigger_summary: Depreciable building basis (any amount), placed-in-service or major remodel within the last three tax years, and no prior cost-segregation study in the packet.

types.name: Augusta
types.trigger_summary: Schedule C or S corporation and a home-ownership document (Form 1098, Schedule A mortgage, or deed). Form 8829 is never ownership. K-1 alone is out.

types.name: Hire kids
types.trigger_summary: Schedule C or S corporation and a dependent child or grandchild, or a labeled child, son, or daughter. Age is optional enrichment.

types.name: Cash drag / overpay
types.trigger_summary: Large refund or estimates well above tax. Underpayment stays on type 4.

types.name: Multi-state
types.trigger_summary: Multi-state W-2 or K-1, or resident state differs from work state. High only when state returns in the packet show a mismatch; otherwise Medium.

types.name: REP
types.trigger_summary: Hours log or context at least 750 and Schedule E real-estate losses. No hours stays silent, with no Medium fallback.

types.name: SEHI
types.trigger_summary: Schedule C or S corporation and self-employed health insurance blank or under the premiums.

types.name: Dependent care / 2441
types.trigger_summary: Children plus care documents or an FSA. High when Form 2441 is incomplete against those documents; otherwise Medium.

types.name: Energy / 5695
types.trigger_summary: Form 5695 or residential energy documents in the packet.

types.name: R&D
types.trigger_summary: Form 6765 or an R&D study in the packet only. A technology Schedule C plus wages stays silent.

types.name: NUA
types.trigger_summary: Form 1099-R employer plan and a company-stock signal, both present.

types.name: Roth conversion room
types.trigger_summary: Traditional IRA or 401(k) and a low taxable-income year signal.

types.name: QSBS §1202
types.trigger_summary: C corporation stock disposal and QSBS or a five-year note in the documents or explicit context. Entity vibes stay silent.

types.name: 1031 / installment
types.trigger_summary: Form 6252 or Form 8824, or a large Schedule D real-estate gain with neither form.
